The '''Grand Symposium''' was a large building that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the reigns of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Grand Symposium was the site of the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]], an [[Standard year/Legends|annual]], four-week-long animal fair and market.
